sections.heading: context
sections.markdown: MONTHLY_IC 2026-10-03. GLOBAL AI-hardware/semi names were killed on the name's own near-term P&L or a loose "other"/valuation basis while the AI-capEx complex re-rated them from outside — the GLOBAL mirror of LESSON-0001 (IDX agri/CPO) one book over.

sections.heading: belief
sections.markdown: "Expensive on its own numbers" was judged from the name's own margin-fade arithmetic and EV/Kelly math — with the AI-capEx complex (hyperscaler capex guides, HBM scarcity, AI-compute re-rating) never carried inside the valuation frame. TSM's own thesis evidenced the re-rating (FY26 revenue +39%, GM 67.7%) yet the kill scored only the name's fade case; AMD's thesis held a dated 2027 DC-doubling guide and ~$725B→$1T hyperscaler capex, and the kill still scored only the name's own momentum/EV arithmetic.

sections.heading: outcome
sections.markdown: T-GLOBAL-TSM-001 killed 2026-09-16 "other" at 413.75 → +14.3% missed (the month's worst miss). T-GLOBAL-AMD-001 killed 2026-08-19 "other" at 484.39 → +30.9% missed (largest single ledger miss). Weak third: T-GLOBAL-TXN-002 (+7.9%, repeat kill governed by LESSON-0002). Counterexample respected: T-GLOBAL-QCOM-001 killed 2026-09-28 "base_rate" at 201.97 → −8.5% avoided loss — the failure mode is NOT "semis all go up"; base-rate discipline stays intact.

sections.heading: cause
sections.markdown: `thesis_wrong` — valuation frame anchored to the name's own numbers while the AI-capEx complex re-rated the name from outside. The complex marker was never set at all, so it was never re-set when the complex moved.

sections.heading: rule
sections.markdown: Carry the AI-capEx complex (hyperscaler capex, AI-compute re-rating) inside the valuation frame for GLOBAL AI-hardware/semi names; a name re-rating with the complex is not "expensive on its own numbers." Base-rate kills are untouched.

sections.heading: evidence
sections.markdown:
- T-GLOBAL-TSM-001 (2026-09-16, reason "other", px_at_kill 413.75) — counterfactual +14.3%. Bear kill on the name's own negative-EV/zero-Kelly arithmetic at margin-fade numbers; the AI-capEx re-rating rode the name after the kill.
- T-GLOBAL-AMD-001 (2026-08-19, reason "other", px_at_kill 484.39) — counterfactual +30.9%. Kill scored the name's own momentum/EV arithmetic despite the 2027 DC-doubling guide and hyperscaler capex path inside the thesis's own evidence.
- (weak third) T-GLOBAL-TXN-002 (2026-08-19, valuation, +7.9%) — repeat kill governed by LESSON-0002; cited with care, not counted toward the ≥2-case bar (TSM + AMD are the two primary cases).
- Counterexample: T-GLOBAL-QCOM-001 (2026-09-28, base_rate, px 201.97) — −8.5% avoided loss, the month's clean win. The rule does not weaken base-rate kills.
- JUDGE not targeted, argued explicitly: both kills consumed a frame built and attacked upstream — the construction fix belongs to ANALYST_GLOBAL (build) and BEAR (attack); JUDGE already holds the repeat-kill re-test (LESSON-0002) covering the TXN-002 subset; every rule gets exactly one home.
- Method-card lane: no existing card's scope contains AI-hardware complex valuation (momentum semis theses cite "VAL_MOMENTUM_CONTINUATION", which is on disk nowhere) — PROPOSAL-2026-10-01 filed in fund record rather than editing a card blindly.
